This market will resolve to "Yes" if De'Aaron Fox averages 25.0 or more points per game during the 2026-27 NBA regular season and meets the NBA's minimum requirement for its official regular-season per-game leaderboard (58 games played or 1,400 points during the 2026-27 NBA regular season, as the NBA applies it). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The per-game average is the player's total regular-season points divided by regular-season games played, as displayed to one decimal place on NBA.com/stats. Only 2026-27 NBA regular-season games count. NBA Cup group-play and knockout games other than the NBA Cup Championship game are regular-season games and count. Statistics from the preseason, the NBA Cup Championship game, the Play-In Tournament, the playoffs and the All-Star Game are excluded. If a player plays for more than one team during the season, his statistics from all teams are combined.

If the 2026-27 NBA regular season concludes early, is shortened, or is truncated for any reason, this market will resolve using available NBA statistics for completed games, with leaderboard qualification applied as the NBA applies it to the shortened season.

If the 2026-27 NBA regular season is cancelled, or postponed after April 25, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve according to the player's average and qualification status in regular-season games completed by that time.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NBA, including NBA.com/stats; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Jayson Tatum averages 10.0 or more rebounds per game during the 2026-27 NBA regular season and meets the NBA's minimum requirement for its official regular-season per-game leaderboard (58 games played or 800 rebounds during the 2026-27 NBA regular season, as the NBA applies it). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The per-game average is the player's total regular-season rebounds divided by regular-season games played, as displayed to one decimal place on NBA.com/stats. Only 2026-27 NBA regular-season games count. NBA Cup group-play and knockout games other than the NBA Cup Championship game are regular-season games and count. Statistics from the preseason, the NBA Cup Championship game, the Play-In Tournament, the playoffs and the All-Star Game are excluded. If a player plays for more than one team during the season, his statistics from all teams are combined.

If the 2026-27 NBA regular season concludes early, is shortened, or is truncated for any reason, this market will resolve using available NBA statistics for completed games, with leaderboard qualification applied as the NBA applies it to the shortened season.

If the 2026-27 NBA regular season is cancelled, or postponed after April 25, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve according to the player's average and qualification status in regular-season games completed by that time.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NBA, including NBA.com/stats; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

raw_market.question: Will Joel Embiid be traded before the 2027 NBA trade deadline?
raw_market.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Joel Embiid is traded to another NBA team between October 9, 2026 and the 2027 NBA trade deadline. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purpose of this market, the 2027 NBA trade deadline is February 11, 2027, 3:00 PM ET, or any revised date and time the NBA officially announces, but no later than February 25, 2027, 11:59 PM ET. A trade counts once it has been officially processed and approved by the NBA. A trade that is later rescinded or voided for any reason after being officially processed will still count. A player who is waived, released, bought out, retires, or otherwise leaves his team by any means other than a trade will not count as traded.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NBA and the teams involved; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
